candidates.change_summary: Transfer sets the new owner to `from` instead of `to`.
Removed the `_ownerOf[id] = to;` assignment so ownership never changes on transfer.
Mint assigns the zero address as owner instead of the recipient.
Removed the `_ownerOf[id] = to;` assignment so minting never records an owner.
Removed `delete _ownerOf[id];` so burned tokens keep their previous owner recorded.
Burn writes `_ownerOf[id] = owner;` instead of deleting it, leaving the token owned after burn.
